page.layout: One column of running text in the centre of the page. Running head at the top. Catchword at the lower right. Page number at the foot. No marginal notes printed. A vertical rule runs down the right side of the text block.

main_text.p: lœrim[?]. Loci enim in Nicolao Grimoalda, Traherone[?], Turnero Medico, Hopero, Rid-laeo, Rogero, Bradfordo, Filpoto & aliis, sc satis explicant, de magno Antichristo & eius tortoribus mitratis ac rafis haec omnia dici. Illam synagogam Romanam, piorum homi-num peremptricem, à Spiritu sancto edo-ctus, Iesabelem impiam, Bestiam cornutam, Draconis prolem, diaboli filiam, satanę spon-sam, blasphemias loquentem, Belluam cocci-neam, Babylonem mysticam, Meretrice ma-gnam cum qua scortati sunt reges terrae om-nes qui de proftitutionis suae vino biberunt: Mulierem circundatam purpura, coccino, au-ro, gemmis & margaritis, habetem poculum aureum omnibus mundi turpitudinibus ac stupris refertum: Matrem fornicationum, & ebriam de sanguine sanctissimorum marty-rum Iesu habitationem daemoniorum, & cu-stodiam omnis immundi spiritus & uolu-cris odibilis, vocaui.

Occasionem, quę primum me mouit, hanc accipe. Anno Domini 1554. post vigesimum suae liberationis per Dei misericordiam an-num, Anglia nostra, ut canis ad vomitum, sa-crosanctum Christi Euangelium, quod ro-bur ac virtus Dei est in salutem omni credenti, contemptibiliter reliquit: & magno Dei aduersario, Romano diabolo & Antichristo, nouam profefsionem fecit: de quo execrabili

page.notes: Catchword "facto" printed at the lower right, partly obscured; read as "facto". The first word of the page ("lœrim") and "Traherone" are doubtful and marked [?]. "hanc" and "habetem" are as printed and look unusual. The opening word of the page is a fragment and is kept as such. Faint stains and a faint mark at the lower left were ignored. The ornament "}{" at the foot was not transcribed as text.
